resources.string:
Text composable

 Displays text and follows 
 the recommended Material 
 Design guidelines.

Image composable

 Creates a composable that 
 lays out and draws a 
 given Painter class object.

Row composable

 A layout composable that 
 places its children 
 in a horizontal sequence.

Column composable

 A layout composable that 
 places its children in 
 a vertical sequence.
